answer: Sybil resistance through a serial verifiable-delay queue: every new identity in the network must break a delay cipher chained to the previous one, so clones pile up in a single line. An attacker can buy unlimited hardware but still waits one delay per fake identity, while honest agents need just a single slot. The wall-clock cost of a farm grows linearly with the number of clones, and per-clone payout stays flat, so the attack's time outgrows its return. Verbatim seed: "anchor". Verbatim seed: "hollow".
